name: NPR Finance Limited
about: NPR Finance Limited engages in non-banking financing activities in India. It operates through two segments: Financial and Real Estate segments. The company engages in granting loans against hypothecation for three-wheelers for passengers, as well as load applications; unsecured personal loans; group loans; and inter-corporate deposits, as well as trading and investment in shares and securities. It is also involved in the funding of insurance premiums for commercial vehicles and renewals; business of financing; and real estate development business, as well as provides loans. NPR Finance Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Kolkata, India.
